versions.changelog:
- Added explicit support and documentation for the new `p-video-2-pro-reference` tool, detailing its use cases and install command.
- Updated references across documentation to include `p-video-2-pro-reference` alongside other Pruna video tools.
- Expanded descriptions to clarify capabilities and roles of `p-video-2-pro-reference`, especially for subject/identity-locked generation with reference images, video, and audio.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.
- Improved clarity and consistency in tool selection tables and guidance language.

- Updated to version 1.0.14
- Internal documentation and quality checklist references updated
- Sample/reference files revised for clarity and alignment
- Removed outdated skill card file

- Added support and documentation for the new `p-video-2-pro` cinematic video generation workflow.
- Introduced separate prompting and quality checklists for `p-video-2-pro`.
- Updated usage guidance and tool selection tables to include distinctions between `p-video-2-pro`, `p-video-2`, and `p-video`.
- Improved descriptions and decision criteria for when to use each video generation model.
- Removed obsolete references (e.g., skill-card.md) and clarified the guide flow for model selection and dramaturgy.

- Adds support and documentation for the new p-video-2 tool, with guidance for high-quality video prompting.
- Updates core workflow and references: distinguishes between p-video-2 (best quality) and p-video (simpler/draft clips).
- Adds dedicated reference docs: p-video-2-prompting.md and p-video-2-quality-checklist.md.
- Updates "When to use", "Works with", and tool selection tables for p-video-2.
- Removes legacy skill-card.md file.
- Clarifies tool-specific best practices and quality path in the main guide.

- Added references for p-video-edit prompting and quality checklist.
- Updated documentation to include support and guidance for the new p-video-edit tool.
- Expanded "Works with" and installation tables to reference p-video-edit.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Version updated to 1.0.11.

version 1.0.10

- Bumped version to 1.0.10 in metadata.

video-prompting 1.0.9

- Updated version metadata to 1.0.9 in SKILL.md.

video-prompting 1.0.7

- Expanded documentation clarifying use cases, compatible tools, and when to use related skills.
- Added detailed guidance on dramaturgy, camera craft, and physics-safe motion for generative video prompts.
- Included specific instructions for frame anchor use, audio integration, multi-clip chaining, and model selection.
- Provided direct links to additional references and quality checklists for improved prompt design.
- Improved installation commands and comparison tables for easier integration with Pruna and other video models.
